summary: Solar Generator Control does not display power generated.

comments.content: What steps will reproduce the problem? 1. Rewire solar arrays 2. Connect them to Solar Generator Control panel The Solar array is outputting power, but the Solar Generator Control is not registering it in the interface. The Power Storage Unit does charge.
i guess persh fixed this cause it works supposedly
